text:
This error occurs because Hermes is set to auto-route or fall back to cloud API providers that require authentication credentials.

To use local **Ollama** and prevent Hermes from attempting to route or fall back to cloud providers, update your configuration in `~/.hermes/config.yaml` to explicitly set `provider: custom` and clear `fallback_providers`:

```yaml
model:
  default: ollama/<model-name>
  provider: custom
  base_url: http://localhost:11434/v1
fallback_providers: []
```

Replace `<model-name>` with the name of your local Ollama model (e.g., `llama3`, `qwen2.5-coder`).
